Spare-component inventory fraction on rolling-stock factory subtotal plus per-train commissioning; does not add duplicate vehicle quantity.

Required mechanical traction work from the analytical candidate journey, scaled by corridor segments; no motor map, losses or measured service duty is implied. Two operating shifts cover the low/base cases; a third shift covers the 24-hour high case. Per-shift staffing × shift count × relief factor × loaded dated wage and explicit second/third-shift premium, discounted for the declared 30-year life. Automation, staffing rules and city operations plans remain unknown.

Annual maintenance fraction on rolling-stock, guideway and station-power factory/installation cost, scaled by service hours against the 18-hour base duty; includes routine labour/consumables, not measured maintenance history.
Discrete replacement events from explicit Class C asset lives, adjusted inversely with operating hours relative to the 18-hour base duty; component lives are not qualified or measured.
One rescue asset and annual standby allowance for the declared corridor; tow rating, access, response time and availability are unknown.
Annual train-km under the 16/18/24-hour service cases × Class C corrective/disruption reserve rate; no observed failure rates, fares, passenger delay valuations or availability evidence.
Year-30 removal and disposal fraction of declared installed CAPEX, discounted to estimate date; salvage, recycling value and site-specific demolition are excluded.

Renew the already-costed service battery/equipment residual account at declared low/base/high service lives. The same account cost is used as a replacement proxy; events coincident with a whole-vehicle replacement are excluded to avoid double counting. No additional initial mass or installed battery is asserted.

limitations: This is one 6 km synthetic periodic corridor scenario with three stations, not a city route or approved deployment.
All 14 cost scopes receive low/base/high Class C estimates; no supplier quote, installed offer, city survey or commercial approval is represented.
The selected physical vehicle identity is unchanged. The six-car route bundle and its cost scenario have separate evaluation identities.
The 20 m box-beam quantities, foundations, stations, haul distances, factory throughput, tariffs, crew sizes and rates remain planning proxies.
Vehicle residual account mass is priced as bounded equipment allowance. It remains unlocated, possible overlap is unresolved, and complete installed mass stays false.
Unknown joints are not assigned an invented count. Their known residual mass allowances are costed once; any additional hardware outside those accounts remains open.
The separate selected vehicle cost estimate is reported as a reconciliation reference and is not added to this whole-system total.
Wayside primary stock, converter, cable/protection, cooling/support and charger costs are Class C quantities; no force map, thermal duty, electrical rating or station supply is qualified.
Service energy is conditional on required mechanical work and declared 35/35/50 kW hotel loads. Charging dwell, battery charge acceptance, roof solar yield and repeated duty are not qualified.
The fleet allowance adds full-tail clearance to each segment and may overlap movement time; it is a conservative costing scenario, not an accepted timetable.
Physical, engineering, manufacturing and operating acceptance remain false.

dimensions.interpretation: Each residual-mass case is evaluated against all three existing low/base/high cost-assumption cases; the two axes are reported separately.

mass_reserve_sensitivity.interpretation: Residual factors are declared sensitivities, not statistical confidence bounds or new physical designs. Every cost case uses replaced residual balances; located geometry stays fixed. Beam quantities and transport are recalculated; foundation area screens are reported, while foundation cost retains fixed Class C area proxies.

cycle_components.clearance_basis: Conservative extra per-station cost allowance; it may overlap with movement-profile time and is not an accepted timetable.
cycle_components.terminal_basis: Periodic ring scenario; no terminal reversal allowance is included.

fleet_basis.reserve_policy: ceil(12% active trainsets) + one cold reserve per line

mass_reserve_sensitivity_boundary.foundation_area_basis: Calculated minimum gravity areas are reported for 300/200/100 kPa soil hypotheses; foundation costs continue to use separate fixed Class C footprint proxies pending route geotechnical and footing design.
mass_reserve_sensitivity_boundary.reason: Each case replaces the existing residual accounts once and recalculates conditional route demand, fleet basis, energy, crowd-control beam quantities and transport. Minimum gravity footing areas are also calculated and reported, but site footing costs remain independent Class C proxies. The cases do not define installed equipment or a physical acceptance result.
mass_reserve_sensitivity_boundary.selected_vehicle_cost_and_process_hours: included in the separate vehicle estimate
mass_reserve_sensitivity_boundary.synthetic_corridor_motion_fleet_energy_a: separate low/base/high residual-mass cases crossed with the independent low/base/high Class C cost cases

vehicle_cost_reconciliation.aggregation_rule: The system estimate prices selected-candidate geometry/account rows as fleet units; it does not add the separate vehicle estimate total.
